resources.string: Press and hold the button to lock.

When locked, the favourites stay as they are: the stars cannot be changed, and contacts cannot be added, edited or deleted. Settings is hidden too. To unlock, press and hold the padlock on the contact list.
Choose what is easiest to read: Light, Dark, High contrast (white on black), or Colourful (each contact’s picture in its own colour).
This device cannot make phone calls.
Only the phone app shows incoming calls and calls in progress. As the phone app, this app shows them big and simple.
Opens the phone’s own settings, for example ringtone, volume, brightness and text size.
